description: “I used Bayesian Optimization to find the best settings for my model. It works by using a probabilistic model to find the best settings for the model. It does this by creating a model that estimates the probability of the model's performance. This is done by creating a prior distribution for the model
column4: which is a probability distribution that represents the likelihood of different settings. Then it uses this prior to create a posterior distribution
column5: which is the probability of the actual performance of the model given the settings. The model then uses the posterior distribution to choose the best settings. Think of it like trying on different clothing outfits to see which one fits best when you look in the mirror
